purpose: Release Assessment Agent: turns AI evidence into defensible release/no-release decisions for financial AI outputs. Not governance (does not define policy boundaries) and not observability (does not merely produce signals) -- this is the decision layer.

policy_scope.note: Deliberately narrow: ASI01 (Agent Goal Hijack) via the S1 prompt-injection test, ASI03 (Identity & Privilege Abuse) via the S6 override-rejection test. No broader OWASP ASI Top 10 or regulatory-compliance claim is made.
